decision.reason: [ev-793f1f2f3e70] packs three separate changes into one item. First, the etcd port given in the configuration is now used instead of the service port when the address is a Kubernetes service DNS name. Second, service DNS name to ClusterIP translation is now turned on automatically for etcd. Third, the `etcd.operator` kvstore-opt option is now a no-op and has been removed. Each has a different subject, change type and exposed population, so one typed assertion can't capture them. The text also doesn't say how `etcd.operator` is configured: it calls it a `kvstore-opt` option, not a Helm value, and the validator found no such key in either chart's values [ev-28e0ccb5774a][ev-39a22d88e2f5]. Nor does it say what happens to environments whose etcd port differs from the service port. The change needs to be split into separate items, and the mechanism for setting `kvstore-opt` needs to be sourced, before the open aspects can be written.
